name: W2 — Chat with your PDF (Docling to pgvector)

nodes.name: Read the synthetic PDF
nodes.notes:
THE DOCUMENT IS GENERATED, NOT COMMITTED. `aistack samples setup` runs samples/fixtures/make-synthetic-pdf.py, which writes a byte-identical one-page PDF whose every byte is accounted for in source. samples/ is bind-mounted read-only at /opt/aistack/samples, so this node can read it and nothing in n8n can modify it.

FOUND BY QA (NOM-302): the first version of this template opened straight on the Docling request and read $json.pdf_base64 out of an empty manual trigger, so it posted `undefined` as a document.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ sources: [{ kind: 'file', base64_string: $binary.pdf.data, filename: 'synthetic.pdf' }], options: { to_formats: ['md'] } }) }}

nodes.name: Parse with Docling
nodes.notes:
BYTES ONLY. Docling's URL fetching is disabled and it sits on a network with no route off the host. It is the component most likely to be executing something an attacker wrote, so it sees one caller and nothing else.

AND IN THIS BUILD THAT ONE CALLER IS NOT n8n. MEASURED (NOM-302, 2026-10-19): docling-serve is on the `parse-owui` /29 and n8n is on apps+gateway+data, so `docling-serve` does not even resolve from n8n —

    $ docker exec aistack-n8n getent hosts docling-serve  -> no output
    $ docker exec aistack-n8n wget -T5 -O- http://docling-serve:5001/health
    wget: bad address 'docling-serve:5001'

This node therefore CANNOT complete as shipped, and `aistack samples run W2` reports BLOCKED with that measurement rather than a pass. Closing the gap means giving Docling a second peer, which moves the untrusted-input component next to the engine that holds every credential: a zone change for manifest.yaml and invariant I7, not a workflow edit. It is the Tech Lead's call, tracked in NOM-302's handoff. Everything else in this template is bound and runnable, so the demo starts working the moment that bridge exists.

nodes.name: Embed via LiteLLM
nodes.notes: LiteLLM REQUIRES A KEY AND ALWAYS DID. MEASURED (NOM-302): an unauthenticated POST to /v1/embeddings returns 401, so this node could not have completed without the credential this release now binds. The key is a LiteLLM virtual key with its own budget, minted by `samples setup` and revoked by `samples teardown` — not the master key.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO w2_chunks (source, content, embedding) VALUES ($1, $2, $3::vector) RETURNING chunk_id, source

nodes.name: Store chunk + embedding
nodes.notes:
One datastore, one backup procedure. Retention deletes a document AND its embeddings in the SAME transaction — a vector that outlives its source is a deleted document you can still search.

The three placeholders are bound through Query Parameters. FOUND BY QA (NOM-302): the first version wrote $1/$2/$3 into the SQL with nothing supplied, so Postgres rejected the statement before any row was written.
